camel_example: aliyun devops GET /api/v4/projects/repository/commit_statuses/list_commit_statuses --region cn-hangzhou --organizationId 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --sha 61cc69557962d29f737a91730b3e86f497f083a3 --repositoryIdentity '2835387 或 codeup/codeup-demo' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries a list of commit statuses with pagination support
description_zh: 查询提交状态列表，支持分页
kebab_example: aliyun devops list-commit-statuses --organization-id 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --repository-identity '2835387 或 codeup/codeup-demo' --sha 61cc69557962d29f737a91730b3e86f497f083a3 --api-version 2021-06-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCommitStatuses

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. It is a string that can be obtained from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the code repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en: The commit ID, which is the commit SHA. Only commit IDs are supported
parameters.name: sha

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
parameters.name: page_size

context.description_en: The string identifier used to distinguish writes from different systems. It is displayed as a title on the corresponding page UI. Default value: default. The length cannot exceed 50 characters, and it is case-insensitive
context.description_zh: 用于区分不同系统写入的字符串标识，会以标题的作用在相应的页面UI处进行展示，默认为default，长度不超过50，且英文大小写不敏感

creator.description_en: The brief information about the user who wrote the commit status
creator.description_zh: 提交状态的写入人简要信息

aliyunPk.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. If the type is Bot, this value is empty
aliyunPk.description_zh: 阿里云账号ID，若type=Bot时，则为空

login.description_en: The username if the type is User, or the application name if the type is Bot
login.description_zh: 若type=User，则为用户名；若type=Bot，则为应用名

type.description_en:
The type of the writer. Valid values:
User: Regular user.
Bot: Application
type.description_zh:
写入人类型

User：普通用户类型
Bot：应用类型

description.description_en: The brief description of the commit status. The description cannot exceed 3,000 characters
description.description_zh: 提交状态的简要描述，且不能超过3000个字符

id.description_en: The ID. This ID has no actual business meaning

sha.description_en: The commit ID, which is the commit SHA. Only commit IDs are supported

state.description_en:
The write status. Valid values:
error: An exception occurred.
failure: Failed.
pending: Running.
success: Successful
state.description_zh:
写入状态

error：异常
failure：失败
pending：运行中
success：成功

targetUrl.description_en: The redirect URL written by the user. The code platform only provides the redirect UI. Generally, this can be set to a URL of a third-party system
targetUrl.description_zh: 用户自行写入的跳转链接，代码平台仅提供跳转的UI，一般可设置为三方系统的链接

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功

false：失败
